BE/FunctionalEntities/FunctionalEntities.label: merchant category code
BE/FunctionalEntities/FunctionalEntities.definition: code used internationally to classify a merchant

BE/LegalEntities/FormalBusinessOrganizat.label: value-added tax identification number
BE/LegalEntities/FormalBusinessOrganizat.definition: tax identifier that identifies a taxable person (business) or non-taxable legal entity for a consumption tax that is assessed incrementally, levied on the price of a product or service at each stage of production, distribution, and sale to the end consumer

BE/LegalEntities/LEIEntities/LegalEntity.label: legal entity identifier
BE/LegalEntities/LEIEntities/LegalEntity.definition: an organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal person as defined in ISO 17442

DER/DerivativesContracts/DerivativesBasi.label: unique product identifier
DER/DerivativesContracts/DerivativesBasi.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying an OTC derivative product that is reportable to a trade repository

DER/DerivativesContracts/Swaps/UniqueSwa.label: unique swap identifier
DER/DerivativesContracts/Swaps/UniqueSwa.definition: identifier for a swap that is used in recordkeeping and swap data reporting

FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistrie.label: North American Industry Classification System code
FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistrie.definition: the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code representing an industry

FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.label: business identifier code
FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.definition: international identifier for financial and non-financial institutions used to facilitate automated processing of information for financial services

FBC/FunctionalEntities/Markets/MarketIde.label: market identifier
FBC/FunctionalEntities/Markets/MarketIde.definition: identifier that specifies a universal method of identifying exchanges, trading platforms, regulated or non-regulated markets, and data reporting services providers as sources of prices and related information in order to facilitate automated processing

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: business number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: unique, 9-digit number that is the standard identifier for legal entities in Canada which are typically a business

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax registration number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RT' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting GST/HST

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: registered charity program number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RR' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for registered charity contribution

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: employer identification number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: unique nine-digit number assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) to business entities operating in the United States for the purposes of identification

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: FDIC Certificate Number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: identifier issued to a depository institution by the FDIC on approval of that institution's application for insurance

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: issuer identification number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: a numbering system that allows a credit, debit, or other card to be identified as having been issued by a particular financial institution

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: Research, Statistics, Supervision and Regulation, and Discount and Credit identifier
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: unique identifier assigned by the Federal Reserve to financial institutions for regulatory and oversight purposes

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: routing transit number
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: unique nine digit identifier, used primarily in the United States, to identify a banking or other financial institution for clearing funds, and, as it appears on a check, denotes the banking institution that holds the account from which funds are to be drawn

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: bank account identifier
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: identifier that identifies a demand deposit account provided by a bank

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: basic bank account identifier
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies an individual account at a specific financial institution in a particular country and which includes a bank identifier of the financial institution servicing that account

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: international bank account identifier
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: identifier for a bank account that is an expanded version of the basic bank account number (BBAN), intended for use internationally

FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProduct.label: unique transaction identifier
FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProduct.definition: sequence of characters identifying a financial transaction uniquely whenever useful and agreed by the parties or community involved in the transaction

FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/Currency.label: currency
FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/Currency.definition: medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it

FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/CurrencyId.label: currency identifier
FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/CurrencyId.definition: sequence of characters representing some currency

FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/MonetaryAm.label: monetary amount
FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/MonetaryAm.definition: measure that is an amount of money specified in monetary units

FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/Price.label: price
FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/Price.definition: amount of money, goods, or services requested, expected, required, or given in exchange for something else

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/PassportNumbe.label: passport number
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/PassportNumbe.definition: national identification number associated with a passport

FND/OwnershipAndControl/Ownership/Digita.label: digital token identifier
FND/OwnershipAndControl/Ownership/Digita.definition: globally unique identifier conformant with ISO 24165 for the registration of digital tokens

FND/Places/Addresses/PhysicalAddress.label: physical address
FND/Places/Addresses/PhysicalAddress.definition: physical address where communications can be addressed, papers served or representatives located for any kind of organization or person

FND/Places/Addresses/Postcode.label: postcode
FND/Places/Addresses/Postcode.definition: sequence of characters used to assist in the sorting of mail

FND/Places/NorthAmerica/USPostalServiceA.label: ZIP+4 Code
FND/Places/NorthAmerica/USPostalServiceA.definition: nine-digit number consisting of five digits, a hyphen, and four digits, which the USPS describes by its trademark ZIP+4

FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/ElectronicMailA.label: electronic mail address
FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/ElectronicMailA.definition: virtual address that defines an electronic messaging endpoint to which email messages can be delivered, typically via an Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) based communications system

FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/TelephoneNumber.label: telephone number
FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/TelephoneNumber.definition: virtual address that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices or services for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/PrimaryC.label: primary card account number
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/PrimaryC.definition: composite identifier of 14 or 16 digits embossed on a bank or payment card and encoded in the card's magnetic strip

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesClassification/.label: financial instrument classification code
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesClassification/.definition: classifier and code for a financial instrument defined in the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI) Code Scheme

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/.label: international securities identification number
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/.definition: security identifier that is defined as specified in ISO 6166, Securities and related financial instruments -- International securities identification numbering system (ISIN)

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/.label: ticker symbol
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/.definition: reassignable identifier of relatively short character string length that is unique within an exchange for a particular financial instrument or listing for that instrument

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: CUSIP International Numbering System (CINS) number
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: 9-character alphanumeric identifier that employs the same 9 characters as CUSIP, but also contains a letter of the alphabet in the first position signifying the issuer's country or geographic region, issued by CUSIP Global Services

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) number
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: nine-character alphanumeric number that identifies all North American stocks and registered bonds for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades, issued by CUSIP Global Services on behalf of the American Bankers' Association, which is a part of Standard and Poor's Capital IQ, that is the National Numbering Agency Identifier for securities issued in North America, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: Euroclear Clearstream common code
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: nine-character alphanumeric securities identifier, issued in Luxembourg, jointly by Euroclear and Clearstream

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: financial instrument global identifier
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: financial instrument identifier that is defined as specified in the Object Management Group (OMG) Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) Specification

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: Refinitiv instrument code
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: proprietary code for financial instruments and indices owned, managed, and distributed by the London Stock Exchange Group's LSEG Financial Solutions (branded as Refinitiv)

SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.label: Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) code
SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentificationI.definition: seven-character security identifier, issued by the London Stock Exchange, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in the United Kingdom, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies
